text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Hakodate Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanefukukitaru aims to earn a winner's star that rivals the star-shaped grounds of Goryokaku Fort.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She enthusiastically heads off to the track to make her mark.
